title: helianthemum rubellum var. prostratum
intro: Helianthemum rubellum var. prostratum, commonly known as Rockrose or Alpine Rockrose, is a low-growing, spreading shrub native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote wound healing. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, triterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
